_readme: S380 SkyAlder, 2026-10-13. The first eLumen capture at Bakersfield (run 38393763513) reads each program page rendered and was still reading at 2.5 hours: every view draws its content from one ~4.5 MB call to api-prod.elumenapp.com/catalog/sites/publish/<catalog>,<path>?tenant=<host> and then waits for the page to settle. This read loads one program page two ways: rendered with "network": true (does a program page make any call beyond the publish one?), and the publish call itself (does its html carry the program's requirements, and what surrounds them?). Two loads, no model call.

questions.program_calls: Which calls a program page makes while it loads, beyond the publish call.
questions.publish_shape: Whether the publish call's html holds the program's requirements and course codes, and what else it carries (styles, the side menu).
